capabilities: Search the hovered word on the web with a modifier key plus click
Open results in the system browser or the Web viewer core plugin
Choose among Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Yandex and Baidu
Tokenize words with Unicode boundaries, including CJK and Thai
Cache tokenization per file in memory and on disk
extras: Cache directory lives in the plugin folder; the README says to exclude cache/ from vault sync. Falls back to the external browser when the Web viewer is off or unavailable.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up an arbitrary word on the web without copying it and pasting it into a search engine.

relations.evidence: The Web viewer core plugin has no public API; the plugin opens it with view type webviewer

summary: Modifier-key hover lookup that web-searches the word under the cursor in the editor, reading view, canvas and PDFs.
